lines.differs: Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ’s payment is conditional on first receiving payment from the End Client, unlike the 30-day fixed term.
Harsher on the vendor than Trustline NBFC: AtliQ's payment obligation is contingent on receiving payment from the End Client, rather than a fixed 45-day cycle.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: Payment is subject to a "pay-when-paid" condition from the End Client instead of a certain 30-day timeframe.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: Confidentiality obligations are unilateral for the vendor instead of being mutual for both parties.
Fairer to the vendor than Meridian Healthcare: Lacks the specific 24-hour breach notification requirement and stringent health data compliance obligations.
Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Confidentiality duties apply only to the vendor rather than being mutual for both contract parties.
Same as Rohan Iyer: The vendor retains ownership of deliverables and tools, granting AtliQ a license rather than transferring title.
Fairer to the vendor than Sunrise Foods: The vendor retains ownership of annotation outputs and deliverables instead of transferring them to AtliQ.
Fairer to the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: The vendor retains title to annotation outputs and deliverables rather than transferring ownership to AtliQ.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: Indemnity is unilateral, covers all breaches, and applies even if AtliQ is negligent.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: Indemnity is unilateral and much broader, covering any breach or service-related loss regardless of negligence.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Broadly covers any breach or service-related loss instead of only third-party IP infringement claims.
Harsher on the vendor than Sunrise Foods: Only AtliQ receives a liability cap and indirect damage exclusion; vendor liability is entirely unlimited.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: The liability cap and exclusion of indirect damages apply only to AtliQ, leaving vendor liability unlimited.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: Liability limits and indirect damage exclusions are unilateral to AtliQ, providing no protection to the vendor.
Harsher on the vendor than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Daily liquidated damages are doubled to 2% of total fees instead of 1%.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: 2% per day of total fees versus 0.5% per week of milestone fees, with no cap.
Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Damages are 2% per day of total fees rather than 1% of the milestone fee.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: Dispute escalation is shortened to 15 days and removes the right to arbitration, favoring court litigation.
Harsher on the vendor than CloudSpan Technologies: Shortens the escalation period to 15 days and shifts jurisdiction from Singapore arbitration to Indian courts.
Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Escalation is halved to 15 days and jurisdiction moves from DIFC to courts in Pune.
